translations.web: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
translations.bsb: You, O LORD, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
translations.kjv: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
translations.asv: Thou, O Jehovah, abidest for ever; Thy throne is from generation to generation.
